problem:

$$
{\begin{aligned}x=2+4t \\ y=-3+5t \\ z=7-6t\end{aligned}
$$

for $t\in (-\infty ,\infty ).$ Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

Question 8
?

Consider the straight line with the parametric equations {x=2+4ty=−3+5tz=7−6t for t∈(−∞,∞). Find the Cartesian equation of this line.

a
x4=y5=z−6
b
x−24=y+35=z−7−6
c
x+24=y−35=z+7−6
d
x−42=y−5−3=z+67
e
x+42=y+5−3=z−67
